messages:
elaine: Heads-up — we’re locking the announce cadence for next Wed 09:00 PT. Need final changelog URL + docs links by EOD today so we can stage the press and blog.
matt: Got it. Changelog is in the repo but I need to confirm a couple of callouts. Will ping when I push the final markdown.
sophia: I can take the docs link once matt confirms the section IDs. If he updates headings, I’ll update anchors and send final links.
ryan: Webinar slot is 11:00 PT same day — marketing wants to sync the demo around the new batching/cost story. Elaine, do we need a separate CTA for webinar signups on the announce page?
elaine: Yes please — short CTA + webinar signup. Also need a benchmark blurb (latency/cost delta) and a one-liner to put above the fold.
matt: pushing changelog now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/compare/release-1.3… (draft). Main points: adaptive batching, quantization profile updates, dedicated fallback routing.
sophia: grabbing anchors. Will convert matt’s markdown to /docs/release-notes/1.3 and share canonical link in a minute.
elaine: can someone confirm the canonical docs link before 5pm? We’ll put it in the social copy and the blog header.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: staging-preview -> 2026-03-25T17:30Z. Preview URL will be posted after successful build.
matt: changelog finalized and PR merged. Final changelog permalink: https://docs.redwood.ai/release-notes/1.3
sophia: docs live at https://docs.redwood.ai/inference/release-1.3 — includes a new examples section for batching config and a migration note.
yan: added webinar CTA copy to the draft landing page: "See how we cut per-token cost by up to 40% — join our live demo" — Elaine, tweak tone if needed.
elaine: love it. Quick edits: make it "up to 40% on typical web workloads" and add time/location. I’ll update the social messages and attach the deck.
matt: FYI: canary rollout starts Thu 09:00 PT with fallback window to 1.2 for the first 2 hours if latency regresses.
elaine: perfect, thanks. I’ll schedule the announcement to hit 09:00 PT and the webinar invite at 11:00 PT. If anything changes, flag here. :rocket:
